milestones.title: Art direction and material library
milestones.detail: Grass, beech, stone, timber, roofs and forage have scoped candidates. New cliff and shoreline sand studies broaden the landscape palette. Bark, ground and companion maps need coordinated scene review.

milestones.title: A complete playable Meadows scene
milestones.detail: A synthetic clearing now combines seven beech trees, both grass types and revised ground in 1080p/4K comparisons. Bark color, ground sampling, shadows, weather, water, buildings and played-world integration remain open.

milestones.title: Every biome, one coherent world
milestones.detail: Meadows leads the work. Black Forest, Swamp, Mountains, Plains, Mistlands, Ashlands, Deep North and Ocean each need scoped artwork and approval.

milestones.title: Buildings, equipment and creatures
milestones.detail: Standard and corner straw now have scoped roof UV and native mip evidence. Complete buildings, companion channels, equipment and creatures remain in the backlog.

milestones.title: Lighting, weather, water and effects
milestones.detail: Develop consistent sunlight, night readability, weather, water and effects across biome transitions. Concepts are not completed game lighting.

milestones.title: Streaming and measured performance
milestones.detail: Bounded grass ownership and sampler-safe asynchronous texture loading pass isolated native checks. Representative 6 GB hardware, exploration frame times and world residency remain unverified.

milestones.title: Installer and platform compatibility
milestones.detail: Linux installation, verification and rollback have local fixture coverage. Wider Linux testing, Windows validation and a supported release package remain.

milestones.title: Contribution workflow and public alpha
milestones.detail: Public source, contribution instructions and an evidence-backed tracker are available. A playable alpha still needs accepted artwork, compatibility results and release documentation.

staged_detail: Straw, beech, grass, dandelions, raspberry, flint and ordinary mushrooms have scoped UV and native evidence. Companion channels, world integration and final art remain open.
